songs.title: A Red, Red Rose
songs.body:
[Verse]
O my [G]Luve is like a red, red [C]rose
That's [G]newly sprung in [D]June
O my [G]Luve is like the [C]melodie
That's [G]sweetly [D]play'd in [G]tune

songs.title: Annie Laurie
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Maxwellton braes are bonnie
Where [G]early [A]fa's the [D]dew
And for [D]bonnie Annie [G]Laurie
I'd [D]lay me [A]doun and [D]dee

songs.title: Comin' Thro' the Rye
songs.source: Robert Burns, from older song (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Gin a body meet a body
[C]Comin' thro' the [G]rye
[G]Gin a body kiss a body
[A]Need a body [D]cry?

songs.title: The Ash Grove
songs.body:
[Verse]
The [G]ash grove, how graceful, how [C]plainly 'tis [G]speaking
The [C]harp through it [G]playing has [D]language for me

songs.title: All Through the Night
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Sleep, my child, and [C]peace attend thee
[D]All through the [G]night
[G]Guardian angels [C]God will send thee
[D]All through the [G]night

songs.title: Sakura
songs.body:
[Verse]
[Am]Sakura, sakura
[E]Noyama mo sato mo
[Am]Miwatasu kagiri
[E]Sakura, sakura
[Am]Hanazakari

songs.title: Cielito Lindo
songs.body:
[Chorus]
Ay, ay, ay, [C]ay
Canta y no [G]llore
Porque cantando se [D]alegran
Cielito lindo, los cora[G]zones

songs.title: La Cucaracha
songs.body:
[Verse]
La cuca[C]racha, la cucaracha
Ya no puede cami[G]nar
Porque no [G7]tiene, porque le falta
Las [C]patitas de atrás

songs.title: Beautiful Dreamer
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Beautiful dreamer, [A7]wake unto me
[A7]Starlight and dewdrops are [D]waiting for thee

songs.title: Jeanie with the Light Brown Hair
songs.body:
[Verse]
I [F]dream of Jeanie with the [C]light brown hair
Borne like a [C7]vapor on the [F]summer air

songs.title: Hard Times Come Again No More
songs.body:
[Chorus]
'Tis the [G]song, the sigh of the [C]weary
[G]Hard times, [A7]hard times, come again no [D]more

songs.title: Battle Hymn of the Republic
songs.source: Julia Ward Howe, 1862 (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Chorus]
Glory, [G]glory, hallelu[C]jah
Glory, [G]glory, hallelu[D]jah
Glory, [G]glory, hallelu[C]jah
His [G]truth is marching [D]on

songs.title: America the Beautiful
songs.source: Katharine Lee Bates / Samuel A. Ward (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
O [G]beautiful for spacious skies
For [C]amber waves of [G]grain
A[G]merica, A[C]meri[G]ca
God [A]shed His grace on [D]thee

songs.title: My Country, 'Tis of Thee
songs.body:
[Verse]
My [G]country, 'tis of thee
Sweet [C]land of [G]liberty
Of thee I [D]sing
Let [G]freedom [D]ring

songs.title: Turkey in the Straw
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]As I was a-gwine down the road
Tired team and a heavy load
I says day-day to the wagon [D]tongue

songs.title: Buffalo Gals
songs.body:
[Verse]
As I was [G]lumbering down the street
[D]Down the street, [G]down the street
Oh, [D]she was fair to [G]view

songs.title: Old Joe Clark
songs.body:
[Verse]
[A]Fare thee well, Old Joe Clark
[G]Fare thee well, I [A]say
I'm a [E]going a[A]way

songs.title: Soldier's Joy
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Grasshopper sitting on a sweet potato vine
[A]Grasshopper sitting on a sweet potato vine
Along come a [A]chicken and says you're [D]mine

songs.title: The Arkansas Traveler
songs.body:
[Verse]
Oh, [D]once upon a time in Arkansas
An [A]old man sat in his little cabin door
A jolly old [A]tune that he played by [D]ear

songs.title: Sweet Betsy from Pike
songs.body:
[Verse]
Did you [C]ever hear tell of Sweet Betsy from Pike
Who [G]crossed the wide mountains with her lover [C]Ike

songs.title: Froggy Went A-Courtin'
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Froggy went a-courtin' and he did ride, uh-huh
[D]Froggy went a-courtin' and he did ride, uh-huh
[C]Sword and pistol by his [G]side
